description: This file contains test scripts for the Project schema, including tests for inventory, cached units, deletion, and staleness checks, utilizing Test2, DateTime, and a custom TestDB module.

methods.name: inventory
methods.description: Test subroutine that verifies the inventory counts for a project with ID 1.

methods.name: articles_cached_units
methods.description: Test subroutine that checks the caching of articles and their units, including memory cycle detection and cache invalidation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Test subroutine that deletes all projects and verifies that certain tables are emptied.

methods.name: stale
methods.description: Test subroutine that checks the staleness of projects based on date, including subtests for specific project IDs.
